reviews.title: Best app!
reviews.text: My Honest StepCoin App Review After 30 Days of Walking I’ve been using StepCoin for a month now and it’s actually one of the better walk-to-earn apps I’ve tried. The concept is simple: you walk, it counts your steps, you earn coins. It pushes you to walk more vigorously which I liked — it’s not just counting lazy steps around your house. What I liked: Free to download, no ads popping up every 5 seconds Super lightweight (under 18MB) and doesn’t drain my battery like other GPS fitness apps Clean tracking, motivates you to live greener and move more No upfront payment or NFT needed like STEPN What could be better: App was removed from Google Play in Oct 2023 so you have to sideload the APK now Rating is around 3.2 stars and I get why — sometimes step counting is a bit off if your GPS is weak Rewards system could be bigger. You earn coins but redemption options are limited compared to Sweatcoin Overall rating: 4/5 for the idea and execution. If you just want an app that makes walking more fun and gives you a little extra motivation to hit your daily goals, StepCoin does the job.

reviews.title: They make it hard to reach the goal
reviews.text: When I started the app, it was pretty easy to earn points and I felt like I would reach the minimum withdrawal ($30) in a reasonable amount of time, like a good balance between having a challenge to work for an actually succeeding. But the closer you get to that minimum withdrawal, the harder they make it for you to earn points. Eg today I hit 270,000 points ($27) and the point reward on one of the games dropped from 60 to 6. Where I was previously getting 6 points per step goal I’ll now only get 1. I will play until I get enough for this reward but after that I probably won’t continue.
